answer_engine_optimization_aeo_stand.question: What does AEO stand for?
answer_engine_optimization_aeo_stand.answer: AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization — optimising content so answer engines and AI assistants can extract and attribute a direct answer from your page.

answer_engine_optimization_aeo_different.question: How is AEO different from SEO?
answer_engine_optimization_aeo_different.answer: SEO aims to rank a page; AEO aims to have a specific passage selected as the answer. AEO focuses on question phrasing, answer length, factual clarity and schema rather than page-level ranking alone.

answer_engine_optimization_long_should_a.question: How long should an answer paragraph be?
answer_engine_optimization_long_should_a.answer: Between 40 and 60 words works best. It is long enough to be complete and short enough to be lifted whole into a snippet or AI summary without truncation.

answer_engine_optimization_faq_schema_st.question: Does FAQ schema still produce rich results?
answer_engine_optimization_faq_schema_st.answer: Google reduced FAQ rich results for most sites, but FAQPage markup remains valuable because AI systems parse it when extracting question-answer pairs. We keep it for retrieval, not for the visual result.

answer_engine_optimization_many_faqs_sho.question: How many FAQs should a page have?
answer_engine_optimization_many_faqs_sho.answer: We standardise on ten genuinely relevant questions per page. Fewer leaves coverage gaps; more usually means padding with questions nobody asks, which dilutes the page.

answer_engine_optimization_aeo_help_voic.question: Can AEO help voice search?
answer_engine_optimization_aeo_help_voic.answer: Yes. Voice assistants read out a single answer, usually sourced from concise, well-structured passages, so the same formatting that wins snippets also wins voice results.

answer_engine_optimization_content_types.question: What content types work best for AEO?
answer_engine_optimization_content_types.answer: Definitions, comparisons, pricing explanations, step-by-step processes, troubleshooting guides and 'how much / how long / what is' questions all convert well into extractable answers.

answer_engine_optimization_i_need_change.question: Do I need to change my whole website?
answer_engine_optimization_i_need_change.answer: No. We start with the 10–20 pages that carry commercial intent, prove the pattern, then roll it across templates so new content is produced answer-first by default.

answer_engine_optimization_quickly_aeo_w.question: How quickly does AEO work?
answer_engine_optimization_quickly_aeo_w.answer: Because it depends on re-crawling rather than authority building, AEO often shows movement in two to six weeks — faster than most SEO work.

answer_engine_optimization_aeo_conflict_.question: Does AEO conflict with good writing?
answer_engine_optimization_aeo_conflict_.answer: No. Answer-first writing is simply clear writing: state the conclusion, then support it. Human readers prefer it too, which is why bounce rates usually improve.
